sections.label: Taskforce, Strategy Review, Advanced Manufacturing
sections.summary: The Singapore Economic Resilience Taskforce will support workers and businesses on tariff challenges, while MTI reviews economic strategy and strengthens advanced manufacturing.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The tripartite Singapore Economic Resilience Taskforce will support workers and businesses to navigate and respond to immediate challenges arising from increased tariffs.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: At the same time, MTI is undertaking an Economic Strategy Review to chart a forward-looking blueprint to better position our economy, businesses and workers in this new landscape.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MTI will intensify efforts to capture opportunities in new growth areas.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will strengthen advanced manufacturing by leveraging technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and biotechnology.

sections.label: Global Enterprises, Low-Carbon Transition, Energy
sections.summary: MTI will help local enterprises internationalise, support firms' low-carbon transition, step up solar deployment, and develop nuclear and hydrogen capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MTI will grow the pool of Singapore Global Enterprises by helping promising local enterprises internationalise and grow into regional or global leaders.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will help firms transition to a low-carbon economy, while safeguarding energy security and maintaining competitiveness.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will step up domestic solar deployment and advance cross-border electricity trading.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will also develop capabilities in other potential low carbon pathways, such as nuclear energy and hydrogen.

sections.label: Expanding Trade Links Emerging Markets
sections.summary: Beyond its 28 Free Trade Agreements, MTI will expand trade links with emerging markets including Latin America, South Asia, Middle East and Africa.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Beyond our 28 Free Trade Agreements, MTI will expand trade links with emerging markets, such as Latin America, South Asia, Middle East and Africa.

sections.label: Trading Frameworks and WTO Reforms
sections.summary: MTI will deepen engagement in CPTPP and RCEP and work with trade-dependent countries to support World Trade Organization reforms.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will deepen engagement in existing trading frameworks, such as the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership and Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership and with other economic regions.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will also work with other trade-dependent countries to support reforms at the World Trade Organization to uphold open, fair and effective global trade.
